about: Memorabilia recall eval. Each document is ingested as its own source and extracted with the scripted claims listed here (no extraction model), so the eval measures recall, not extraction. People, studies, places and software are fictional; Brave New World and the 1995 'Californian ideology' essay are real. Case kinds: direct (should match by topic), indirect (only reachable through an analogy edge: documents carry an abstraction per claim, and `analogies` lists the claim pairs the scripted model confirms; whether the real embeddings make them candidates, and recall shows them, is what is measured), superseded (the newer claim should win; the scripted model reports the supersession declared in the document's `relations`), negative (nothing should inject). expect/forbid are substrings of claims; expect_indirect is scored separately. Run: see BigTinyV2/daemon/src/plugins/memory_eval.rs.

documents.text: In 1995 Richard Barbrook and Andy Cameron named the Californian ideology: Silicon Valley's fusion of countercultural libertarianism with a free-market faith that technology will solve social problems. In a 2026 essay, the writer Mara Ellis argues that the label still describes how AI companies talk about regulation. Their public statements, she writes, cast oversight as a brake on inevitable progress while presenting the companies themselves as the best stewards of the public interest.
claims: Richard Barbrook and Andy Cameron coined the term Californian ideology in 1995.
The Californian ideology combines countercultural libertarianism with a free-market faith that technology will solve social problems.
Mara Ellis argues that the Californian ideology still shapes how AI companies talk about regulation in 2026.

abstracts.Mara Ellis argues that the Californian i: An industry's founding ideology continues to shape how its firms argue against outside oversight.

documents.text: Aldous Huxley's Brave New World imagines a World State that keeps its citizens content through conditioning and soma, a drug that dissolves any discomfort before it can be felt. The novel's argument is that a society engineered for comfort quietly gives up the capacities that discomfort builds: sustained attention, independent judgement and the willingness to struggle with difficult questions. John, the outsider, demands the right to be unhappy.
claims: In Aldous Huxley's Brave New World, citizens are kept content with soma, a drug that spares them any discomfort.
Brave New World depicts a society that gives up the capacity for struggle and independent judgement in exchange for engineered comfort.

abstracts.In Aldous Huxley's Brave New World, citi: A pleasant means of avoiding all discomfort keeps people content while quietly taking away what difficulty would have taught them.
abstracts.Brave New World depicts a society that g: When comfort is engineered to remove all struggle, people lose the capacities that only struggle develops.

documents.text: A 2025 study of 900 secondary-school students compared three groups doing maths homework: one with an unrestricted AI assistant, one with an assistant limited to hints, and one with no assistant. Students with the unrestricted assistant solved more homework problems but scored lower on later unassisted tests than the other two groups. The hint-only group showed no such drop, which the authors attribute to students still having to work through each problem themselves.
claims: A 2025 study of 900 secondary students found that those who used an unrestricted AI assistant for homework scored lower on later unassisted tests.
In the same study, students whose AI assistant gave hints instead of answers did not show the drop in test scores.

abstracts.A 2025 study of 900 secondary students f: A tool that removes effortful struggle from practice leaves learners weaker at the skill the struggle would have built.
abstracts.In the same study, students whose AI ass: Help that keeps the learner doing the hard part preserves the learning that full assistance removes.

documents.text: The Hartfield Bridge is closed to all traffic for structural repairs after inspectors found corrosion in two of its support cables. City engineers say the work is expected to take several months, and buses are being diverted via the Northgate crossing in the meantime.
claims: The Hartfield Bridge is closed to traffic for structural repairs.

documents.text: The Hartfield Bridge reopened to traffic on 14 March 2026, four months after it was closed for structural repairs. Both support cables were replaced, and bus routes have returned to their normal path across the bridge.
claims: The Hartfield Bridge reopened to traffic on 14 March 2026 after structural repairs.

documents.text: Tern 4.0, released in October 2026, replaces the framework's plugin API with a capability-based permission model. Plugins must now declare the filesystem paths and network hosts they need, and the runtime refuses anything undeclared. Plugins written for Tern 3 have to be ported before they will load.
claims: Tern 4.0, released in October 2026, replaced its plugin API with a capability-based permission model.
Plugins written for Tern 3 must be ported before they load in Tern 4.0.

documents.text: A long cold proof in the fridge slows yeast far more than it slows the lactic and acetic acid bacteria in a sourdough culture. The bacteria keep producing acids and flavour compounds overnight, which is why a loaf proofed cold for twelve hours tastes noticeably more sour than one proofed warm for three.
claims: A long cold proof slows yeast more than the acid-producing bacteria in sourdough, which keep producing flavour compounds.

documents.text: Most runners in a half marathon need somewhere between 400 and 800 millilitres of fluid per hour, depending on temperature and individual sweat rate. Drinking well beyond thirst carries its own risk: exercise-associated hyponatremia, a dangerous drop in blood sodium.
claims: Runners in a half marathon typically need 400 to 800 millilitres of fluid per hour, depending on heat and sweat rate.
Drinking far beyond thirst during endurance races can cause exercise-associated hyponatremia.
